results.canonical_news_title: Your Robot’s Safety Functions Already Work. What If the Input Lies?

global_competitors.name: Radeis
global_competitors.reason: Pre-deployment robot cyber-safety platform tests manipulated sensor/input scenarios, links cyber risk to unsafe robot behavior and prioritizes remediation before release.

adjacent_competitors.name: Xium Labs Robotics Security Testing
adjacent_competitors.reason: Tests sensor spoofing, model integrity and safety-related controls but is a security-testing service rather than an evidence workspace.

competition_search_terms: robot sensor spoofing safety validation platform input trust
industrial robot cyber safety test evidence sensor spoofing
robot sensör spoofing güvenlik doğrulama yazılımı
results.market_gap: The evidence-workspace UX is lighter, but the core job of validating whether manipulated inputs can break otherwise-safe robot behavior is already directly productized.
results.mvp: Input-trust register, safety-dependency matrix, spoof/failure test cases and remediation evidence.
results.working_logic: Map safety function to sensor/data dependencies; define adversarial/failure cases; record test evidence; flag failed trust assumptions; track remediation.
results.marketing_strategy: Robot integrators, OT security and plant engineering.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot around one connected robot cell and its perception/safety inputs.
results.main_risk: Specialized cyber-safety validation vendors own deeper simulation/testing.
results.validation_assumption: Radeis meets strict same-customer + same-job + substantially-same-workflow test.
results.local_applicability_rationale: Turkish industrial-robot verification research confirms domestic relevance, but no concrete Lüleburgaz installed-base evidence was verified; local label is not assigned.
results.rejection_reason: Radeis directly validates robot safety under manipulated sensor/input conditions and records remediation-oriented results.

results.canonical_news_title: 정부 지원 GPU 70%, 가동률 50% 미만…AI 자원 관리 공백

global_competitors.name: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Task Governance
global_competitors.reason: Shared accelerator governance monitors cluster allocation state, quota policy and idle capacity, then dynamically makes unused compute borrowable/reassignable across teams.

adjacent_competitors.name: ReclaimIdleResource
adjacent_competitors.reason: Utilization-aware GPU preemption/reclaim at scheduler level; directly solves idle reclaim but lacks program-level milestone/evidence workflow.

adjacent_competitors.name: sgpu
adjacent_competitors.reason: Tracks allocation versus compute, efficiency and wasted GPU-hours; monitoring/accounting rather than renewal/reclaim decision ledger.

competition_search_terms: shared GPU allocation utilization reclaim governance software
GPU quota utilization idle reclaim program management
GPU tahsis kullanım geri alma yazılımı
results.market_gap: The proposed human program ledger adds milestones/reasons/renewal evidence, but the core allocation-utilization-reclaim job is already handled by shared-GPU governance/scheduler products.
results.mvp: Allocation register, utilization CSV import, workload milestones, idle exceptions, reclaim alerts and decision history.
results.working_logic: Register allocation/team; import utilization; compare against thresholds and milestones; request exception evidence; renew/reclaim/reallocate with decision record.
results.marketing_strategy: Universities, accelerators and pooled AI infrastructure programs.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with one shared GPU program using periodic utilization exports.
results.main_risk: Cloud/cluster schedulers increasingly automate the core reclaim decision.
results.validation_assumption: HyperPod meets the strict core-job test even though it is infrastructure-native rather than a standalone lightweight ledger.
results.rejection_reason: Shared-GPU governance platforms already monitor allocations/quotas and dynamically reclaim or redistribute idle accelerator capacity.

results.canonical_news_title: Port of Oakland handles 173,818 TEUs in August as exports rise from July

global_competitors.name: SeaVantage
global_competitors.reason: Port/terminal congestion intelligence provides operational signals for routing/rebooking decisions and integrates them into container visibility workflows.

global_competitors.name: Portcast
global_competitors.reason: Predictive port congestion and shipment visibility helps shippers/forwarders anticipate gateway disruption and adjust routing/operations.

adjacent_competitors.name: IMF PortWatch
adjacent_competitors.reason: Public/open port activity benchmarking signal source; does not itself provide the proposed decision ledger.

competition_search_terms: port congestion analytics routing decision software shipper forwarder
port volume gateway routing intelligence software
liman yoğunluk rota optimizasyon forwarder yazılımı
results.market_gap: Using monthly public statistics is cheaper, but the customer job—turning port condition signals into routing review—is already served by predictive port-intelligence products.
results.mvp: Monthly port-stat import, normalized scorecard, threshold alerts, routing-review tasks and decision history.
results.working_logic: Import port statistics; normalize trend metrics; flag material shifts; open routing review; record route decision and later outcome.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with one forwarder monitoring 3-5 gateways.
results.main_risk: Public monthly data is too lagging versus commercial predictive feeds.
results.validation_assumption: SeaVantage and Portcast meet same customer/core decision workflow despite richer data.
results.local_applicability_rationale: Türkiye/Trakya exporters could use the workflow, but no Lüleburgaz-specific buyer/workflow evidence was established in this validation.
results.rejection_reason: Predictive port-intelligence products already turn gateway congestion/activity signals into actionable routing and operational decisions.

results.canonical_news_title: Every AI agent needs a kill switch: DigiCert launches AI Trust Manager

global_competitors.name: Microsoft Agent Registry / Agent 365
global_competitors.reason: Central agent inventory with ownership, governance gaps, lifecycle actions, block/unblock/delete/start/stop and owner reassignment.

global_competitors.name: Google Cloud Agent Registry
global_competitors.reason: Centralized catalog to register, discover and govern agents, tools and endpoints, directly addressing fragmented tool access and governance.

global_competitors.name: AWS Agent Registry
global_competitors.reason: Searchable governed catalog records what agents/tools exist, who owns them and whether they were reviewed.

adjacent_competitors.name: DigiCert AI Trust Manager
adjacent_competitors.reason: Stronger cryptographic identity/authority/revocation control plane; candidate explicitly proposed a lighter non-PKI alternative.

competition_search_terms: AI agent registry ownership permissions revoke governance
agent inventory owner lifecycle deprovision software
AI agent envanter sahiplik yetki iptal yönetimi
results.market_gap: SMB/lightweight positioning does not create a distinct core workflow; major platforms now expose agent inventory, ownership and lifecycle governance directly.
results.mvp: Agent registry, owner, permission manifest, expiry/review calendar, revoke runbook and audit export.
results.working_logic: Register agent; assign accountable owner; record tools/data permissions; schedule review/expiry; trigger revoke/offboarding checklist; export evidence.
results.marketing_strategy: SMB IT/security teams adopting multiple agent platforms.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with a 20-100 person company using agents across two platforms.
results.main_risk: Native cloud/product admin consoles rapidly absorb governance basics.
results.validation_assumption: Microsoft/Google/AWS registries satisfy same inventory/ownership/lifecycle governance job.
results.rejection_reason: Microsoft, Google and AWS already provide governed agent registries with ownership and lifecycle controls; lightweight implementation is feature-level differentiation.

results.canonical_news_title: Beyond tariffs, a storm of pressures is hampering SMB supply chains

turkiye_competitors.name: BilTAY SatNET SCM
turkiye_competitors.reason: Türkiye SCM product explicitly provides supply-chain simulation, scenario/what-if modeling, inventory visibility and proactive risk decisions.

global_competitors.name: V5 Ultimate AI MRP Scenario Planner
global_competitors.reason: Multi-variable disruption scenarios across demand/supplier/capacity, safety-stock impact, comparable named scenarios and decision trail directly match the proposed job.

global_competitors.name: SAP Supply Chain Planning
global_competitors.reason: Dynamic scenario planning, AI-supported inventory optimization, disruption response and cross-functional decision workflows cover the same planning job at enterprise scope.

competition_search_terms: SMB inventory disruption scenario planner multi variable safety stock
supply chain what-if scenario decision log inventory
Türkiye tedarik zinciri senaryo what-if stok planlama yazılımı
results.market_gap: A low-cost SMB interface could be simpler, but the scenario→inventory tradeoff→decision workflow is already directly productized, including by a Turkish vendor.
results.mvp: Scenario assumption ledger, SKU risk matrix, buffer decision comparison, decision log and post-event variance review.
results.working_logic: Define simultaneous shocks; apply to SKU/supplier assumptions; compare buffer/order/delay choices; record selected decision; review forecast miss after event.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with an SMB using spreadsheet-based inventory planning.
results.main_risk: Established SCM tools and ERP modules already cover what-if planning.
results.validation_assumption: V5 and BilTAY satisfy strict direct definition; SAP confirms category maturity.
results.local_applicability_rationale: The workflow is directly applicable to Turkish manufacturers/distributors, but no concrete Lüleburgaz buyer evidence in this validation supports a Lüleburgaz label.
results.rejection_reason: Direct global and Turkish SCM products already provide multi-variable scenario/what-if inventory planning and decision support.
